categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Integrates functional test discovery into the CMake build system (`CMakeLists.txt`, `test/functional/CMakeLists.txt`) and modifies CI test scripts (`ci/test/03_test_script.sh`).
categories.rationale: Enables opt-in CTest orchestration of Python functional tests and exercises it in native macOS CI. As author notes, this allows CI and developers to "use the same standard CTest interface to run all unit and enabled functional tests" with standard filtering and IDE integration, providing useful contributor tooling without resolving an urgent platform or CI failure.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Has the Tests label and updates the functional test framework runner (`test/functional/test_runner.py`) with direct execution mode and test manifest emission.
categories.rationale: Adds test harness capabilities enabling individual functional tests to be queried and executed directly by external test runners. The author explains that this makes functional tests "visible to CTest-aware IDEs, CTest dashboards, CDash, and all other downstream tooling", offering clear developer convenience while being reasonably deferrable.
